summary: Implement the general read-only JSONL Vault retriever CLI with TDD
description: Build a fast evidence retriever for broad natural-language queries, with freshness gates, bounded snippets, source citations, and explicit abstention.
acceptance: CLI queries a synthetic FTS5 index read-only and returns a versioned evidence packet
General queries are supported without entity-specific routing assumptions
Missing, stale, malformed, and unsafe inputs fail closed with documented exit codes
Focused RED and GREEN evidence plus full regression checks are recorded
